title: SPQRFi
tagline: SPQRFi: AI powered DeFi made easy just connect, deposit, and let smart agents grow your funds.
description: SPQRFi is a sophisticated DeFi protocol that combines traditional ERC4626 vault functionality with AI-driven strategy execution. The system allows users to deposit assets into vaults while AI agents automatically optimize yield through whitelisted strategies including swaps, lending, and other DeFi protocols.
how_its_made:
We use the Blockscout REST API to retrieve historical data from both Rootstock and Flow. This data serves two key purposes: it helps train our risk assessment models, and it also acts as a data provider for our main AI agent.

On Rootstock, we integrated protocols such as Sovryn and LiFi to execute lending operations and deploy assets into the DLLR/BTC liquidity pool.

On Flow, we utilized Kittypunch for lending and FlowStrategy to deposit FLOW tokens and generate yield directly on the network.

This cross-chain data aggregation allows our system to analyze diverse DeFi environments, enabling smarter and more informed strategies.
